what: You read a transcript while you listen. Some words in the text are different from what the speaker says. You click those words.
tests: Listening and reading: noticing small differences between speech and text.

scoring.note: Pearson says each selected word is scored as either correct or incorrect.

strategy: Follow the text with your eyes or the mouse pointer as the speaker talks.
Click a word as soon as you hear something different.
Do not click words you are not sure about. In our practice marking, each wrong click cancels a right one.
example_prompt: Text: 'The festival takes place every summer in the old town.' Speaker says 'every spring'.

strong.why: It is the only word that is different.

medium.why: One right and one wrong click cancel out in our practice marking.

weak.answer: Clicks nothing because they lost their place.

mistakes: Losing your place in the text.
Clicking many words to be safe.
